tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// mkhan chen rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan par rjes gnang zhu dus kyi 'bul yig bzhugs so// phyogs bcu rnam 'dren yon tan mtsho// smon lam rmad byung mandā ras// bsrubs skyes gdan gsum rdzogs pa'i lha// skye dgu'i gdung sel rgyal gyur cig /rgyal rnams yon tan bkod pa'i zhing*// khyod sku'i ba spu'i gar ston pa'i// thub chod 'di ltas mar gyur 'gro// tha mal mkhyen pa bzod lags grang*// lus can srid pa'i sdug bsngal las// gdon pa'i cho ga sdom gsum gyi// bsil ba'i grong 'khrid legs 'doms pas// char ldan sprin gyi gdung skyob 'gran// brtse dang byang chub sems kyis thugs// shin tu mnyes par byas min na// ris bral yid can thugs rje ches// gzhar yang mi gtong 'ching 'di ci// dpag yas mkhyen brtse nus mtha' de// blta 'dod grags pa'i mu khyud kyis// lta byed stong sprul btsal ma mngon// sa srungs stegs la dub bam snyam// rgyal ba'i ring lugs bskyangs pa'i tshul// tshogs gsum lam du song ba'i khur// phrag par theg dka'i dogs pa yis// brtan mas rang lus sra brtan sprul// bsod nams brgya phrag mdzub rtse dag /skye mang bsgyur bskrun tsakra ris// bkrag cher bkra ba'i bgrod byed dag /bskal par brling ba'i dam bca' bzung*// gang tshe legs po shis pa'i sgra// tshangs dbyangs 'bum sdes bya lam nas// yid srubs thul dbang bye ba phrag /mgrin bsdebs bsngags pas mnga' gsol gang*// de dran ri dwags rgyal po brgyad// rgyags cher glal ba'i dpung sbom gyis// rin chen brtsegs pa'i bzhugs stegs ni// kun gyi blar bteg ga la bar// 'dzum sgros chu skyes bzhad pa yi// khong nas nyer 'phos legs gsungs kyi// sbrang rtsi 'thungs pa'i bka' slob 'bangs// mkha' lding rgan bus 'di skad gsol// gnyen zlar gyur pa'i dal rten can// nye bar lhags pa'i gzhon nu 'di// glo bur bro 'tshal dregs pa yib// glang chen nyi mas gdungs bzhin mchis// gal te gegs rkyen ma stor na// mi lus snying po dam chos kyi// skal ba ldan dang rang gzhan don// 'byung du re bas bcings pa gang*// 'tsho 'chi ji ltar gyur kyang bla// skyabs mchog thugs rje byin rlabs zer// gzhibs pas rten gyi ku mu dā// skal bzang ge sar dgod bya'i phyir// spyan 'dren gsol ngor ston mchog la// bzang mos gsol btab bzhin byon nas// ring 'tsho'i dbang dang bcom ldan 'das// thams cad rig pa'i dbang bskur stsal// ra 'dod shing rta gdeng ba gang*// thugs rje'i dpag bsam rgyas pa las// ci 'dod 'bras bus bkang ba'i drin// stong gsum ril pos 'tshob dka' mod// ston pa'i sngon rabs dman pa'i skyer// bde gshegs shākya thub chen la// 'jam gang phul nas thugs bskyed par// byang chub lung bstan ji bzhin dgongs// 'dir maṇḍal gyi brda mtshon du/

lha dar dkar po/ thub dbang gser sku/ sman tshe yug ling dmar sngo gnyis/ gos chen/ ras rnams yug re/ wa skyes/ spre/ spyang ki sram/ g.yi/ gung*/ gzig rnams kyi pags pa re/ spu har ko ba bubs/ mgo dkar snam bu/ gser zho bcu/ rta pho/ 'ga' dkar yug bcas bcu dgu tshan 'di bka'i slob 'bangs bande tshul khrims rin chen can gyis gus par phul// ༈ //srid zhi'i skyabs kyi gtso bo rin cheṃn gsum// kun 'dus che ba'i yon tan miṃ 'gyuraṃ khrir// phyogs las rnam par rgyalaṃ ba'i dge mtshaṃn gzugs// thub dbang bstan pa'i rgyan du brtan gyur cig /bgrang yas skye bar mngon par 'du byas bsod nams rin chen rdul gyi tshogs// smon lam rmad byung dri khyer stobs kyis bsrubs skyes skye ba'i gyen 'phyur dbang*// lung rtogs kyis bsdus bstan pa'i mi rmi'i grong khyer ji snyed bla nas blar// mngon par 'degs pa'i snying stobs mi dman bslab gzhir spyod pa'i lus stobs rdzogs// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kun gyi brjod bya so sor ma 'dres par// lung rigs gdams pa rjes su 'brel bar legs par 'doms pa'i dga' ston bzang*// tha dad gdul bya'i blang dor gnas rnams 'dzad med rtag 'jo dag byed bzhi'i// rgyun chen bar med 'bebs pa'i ya mtshan gdengs can ma dros gnas la 'phya// phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung gis bstan bya ngo mtshar bye bas mgon khyod kyi// mkhyen klong yangs par bsti gnas bgyis kyang gzhar yang rgyags pa mi mnga' mtshar// 'on te 'od srungs byin gyi dkyil 'khor nyal 'gro gyi gyur 'bab kyi rgyun// gang dag btung bas rin chen 'byung gnas ngoms pa'i dus dag nam zhig mthong*// srid pa gsum na zla bral stobs dang bsnyengs bral ma 'dres chos la sogs// mtha' klas yon tan phal mo che zhig bdag gir bgyis na mang rtul gyi// skye bo blang dor 'dzol ba'i go sar gyi nar 'phyan la mi brtse ba// rgyal ba'i myu gu'i spyod pa'i gzhung gi 'gal zla nyid du ma gyur grang*// phyogs kun snang ba dkar pos bkab 'di gsar ldan dus kyi zla snang ngam// dpyod ldan la 'os rnam dkar phrin las mu med phyogs su spros sam ci// 'on te ngan 'gro 'khor ba'i gdung ba zad par 'phrog pa'i mthu chen thob// gang phyir bstan skyong chen po nyid kyi mdzad bzang nyid du nges par rtogs// e ma rab 'byams zhing na 'tsho gzhes bzhugs pa'i thams cad mkhyen kun gyi// gsang gsum rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i bkod pa brku ba'i chom rkun ma brtsams par// skyabs mchog khyod gcig sku la rdzogs pa 'di ko ci zhes khrung khrung 'dzoms// legs bris yul nas tshogs gsum zol gyis 'di na lhags snyam khyod zhabs drung*// bgrod dka'i nor ldan gom pas ma bcal zhing*// dbyig gi zong brgyas lo zlar ma bsgrubs par// skyabs gsum 'dus pa gtsug gi rgyan thob pa'i// slob 'bangs gyi na pa des 'di skad gsol// deng 'dir chos nor 'dod pa thar pa'i sdes// mngon par rgyags pa'i mi bdag sā la'i phreng*// tshar du dngar bas dge bcu'i bka' khrims kyis// legs par bsrungs pa'i 'od srung byin gyi ltor// dpal mchog he ru ka dpal sa skya pa// brtse chen snying po brgyud par bcas rnams dang*// bstan pa'i snang byed rgyal tshab e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang bshad sgrub dar bab chos grwa 'dir// mu to'i brtul zhugs gnas kyang mos gus stobs// spyan 'dren gsol 'debs spyi brtol bskyed pa bzhin// kho bo'i sdum par zhal rdul dri med kyis// legs btab lha mi'i mchod rten mchog tu bskrun// gcig tu 'gro tshogs ngan 'gro rgyur bcas las// skyob byed dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dbang bskur dang*// dge tshogs byang chub smin pa'i yongs bsngo bcas// re ba'i shing rta mngon 'dod nor bus bkang*// thugs brtses bskyangs pa'i sku drin bem chos su// gyur pa gang tshe theg dka'i dogs pa yis// nor 'dzin bu mo skrag pas 'dar ro zhes// ba spu'i tshogs kyang langs nas blta min nam// bkra shis pa'i lha dar dkar po bcas tshan grangs 'di dag thu mi'i lugs srol 'chang ba'i slob ma'i tha chung gyi na pas gus par phul ba lags so// ces pa 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor/

bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ //stobs bcu'i dbang phyug yongs kyi gsang ba gsum// smon lam rjes dran tshangs pas skye ba 'dir// mi yi srid par bsgyur nas yid can rnams// gang 'dul thabs kyis 'khrid mchog rgyal gyur cig /tshad med thugs rje'i skyabs sbyin phyag rgya nyid// 'di nas byang chub snying po'i bar brkyangs nas// ris su ma chad skye 'gro ngan song dang*// 'khor ba'i 'jigs skyob yon tan gri bsil gter// gang sku bskal pa'i pha rol mthong min par// de srid lhar bcas skye dgu srid dang zhi'i// 'jigs las skyob pa'i rten gling gcig pu nyid// brtan byed gdong lngas mtshan pa'i zhabs stegs su// rtse gcig mos pa'i snye ma'i khur lci bas// lus rten dbyar skyes sdong bu phra ldem gyis// ma bzod nor ldan stegs la ngal gso ba// phyag 'tshal zol gyis bsgribs snyam 'di skad gsol// dus 'das dge slong bsod nams dbang phyug can// 'khor ba ngan 'gro'i skye sgo khegs nges pa'i// rnam dag cho ga yongs bsngos rjes bzung ba'i// thugs rje lha lam min pa su zhig sgrun// sku drin cha shas gsob mtshon maṇḍal gyi brda mtshon dngos rdzas phra mo 'di dag lags/ zhes 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
